claim.claim-text: 2. The folding mechanism as claimed in claim 1, characterized in that the central line (L1) of each of said pivot pins (15, 15', 15", 150) of said pivot seat unit (10, 10', 10", 100) is orthogonal to the axial line (L), said support rod (21) of each of said support units (20, 20", 200) further having an outer surface (213), said push member (22) of each of said support units (20, 20", 200) further having a push block (222, 222", 220) that protrudes toward the axial line (L) from said outer surface (213) of said support rod (21) of said support unit (20, 20", 200), that is formed with said first and second push surfaces (224a, 224b) of said push member (22), and that has an angled portion (225) formed between said first and second push surfaces (224a, 224b), said angled portion (225) of said push member (22) of each of said support units (20, 20", 200) being proximate to the axial line (L) when said support units (20, 20", 200) are in the folded state, said angled portion (225) of said push member (22) of each of said support units (20, 20", 200) pushing said push member (22) of the adjacent support unit (20, 20", 200) during the conversion of said support units (20, 20", 200) between the folded state and the unfolded state.

3. The folding mechanism as claimed in claim 2, characterized in that, for each of said support units (20, 20", 200), said first and second push surfaces (224a, 224b) extend from said angled portion (225) toward said outer surface (213) of said support rod (21), and are flat.

4. The folding mechanism as claimed in claim 2, characterized in that said pivot seat unit (10) further includes an outer surrounding wall (112) that defines a space (111) therein and that surrounds said support units (20), each of said pivot pins (15) being connected to said outer surrounding wall (112), and having an inner section that extends into said space (111) and that extends through the respective one of said support units (20).

5. The folding mechanism as claimed in claim 4, characterized in that said pivot seat unit (10) includes three of said pivot pins (15) that are equi-angularly spaced apart from each other about the axial line (L), said folding mechanism comprising three of said support units (20), wherein cross-sections of said push blocks (222) of said support units (20) when examined perpendicular to the axial line (L) have contours that are identical to each other, and that are symmetrical about the axial line (L), the central line (L1) of each of said pivot pins (15) of said pivot seat unit (10) intersecting the axial line (L).

6. The folding mechanism as claimed in claim 2, characterized in that said support units (20, 20", 200) surround said pivot seat unit (10', 10", 100), each of said pivot pins (15', 15", 150) having an outer end portion (151') located at one side of the respective one of said support units (20, 20", 200) opposite to said pivot seat unit (10', 10", 100).

7. The folding mechanism as claimed in claim 1, characterized in that said push block (222') of said push member (220') of one of said support units (200') has an extension (226') that extends away from said first push surface (224a') of said push block (222'), said second push surface (224b') of the one of said support units (200') having an inner section (227') that is proximate to said first push surface (224a') of the one of said support units (200'), and an outer section (228') that is distal from said first push surface (224a') and that corresponds in position to said extension (226'), said push block (222') of at least one of the others of said support units (200') having a structure substantially the same as said push block (222') of the one of said support units (200').
